parameters.content:
## Reset the onboarding demo

Run this before the main workflow.

Start dates are computed from today rather than stored fixed, so one hire is always starting tomorrow and one has always already started. Without that the demo ages into every hire having begun months ago and the whole readiness picture goes flat.

It wipes the task table on purpose: H-004 is left with no tasks at all, which is what gives the main workflow something to derive from the checklist.
